SYM.name: Symmetric (Euclidean S4)
SYM.description: All eight +/- index combinations are equal.  Arises on Euclidean S4: real discrete spectrum → G^{++}=G^{--}=G^{+-}=G^{-+}.
SYM.physical_scenario: Compact Euclidean S4 background, no Lorentzian time ordering

ANTISYM.name: Antisymmetric (branch sign flip)
ANTISYM.description: I[+,+,+] = +1, I[-,-,-] = -1.  Would arise if the CTP action assigns opposite signs to forward/backward.
ANTISYM.physical_scenario: CTP branch sign asymmetry, no mixing
ANTISYM.role_implication: final_coefficient_candidate or cosmo_coefficient_candidate — but CTP causality violated

RESP1.name: One-response (one backward vertex)
RESP1.description: One of the three triangle vertices is on the - branch.  Represents a cross-branch mixing with one response insertion.
RESP1.physical_scenario: CTP cross-propagator G^{-+} inserting one backward vertex
RESP1.role_implication: final_coefficient_candidate or cosmo_coefficient_candidate — but CTP causality violated

SECTOR_ASYM.name: Sector-asymmetric (N != D sector prefactors)
SECTOR_ASYM.description: I[+,+,+]=pi/2, I[-,-,-]=pi*sqrt(3)/4. Models the scenario where N and D sectors have different Euler-density prefactors (C_Euler,cosmo vs C_Euler,final), with the S4 loop appearing in both but with sector-specific weights.
SECTOR_ASYM.physical_scenario: Two-sector GRUT action: C_cosmo=pi/2 in N, C_final=pi*sqrt(3)/4 in D
SECTOR_ASYM.role_implication: pi/2 is NOT a branch-topology coefficient; sectors carry the asymmetry

euclidean_s4_analysis.claim: On compact Euclidean S4, G^{++}=G^{--}=G^{+-}=G^{-+}=G_E (all CTP propagator components are equal).
euclidean_s4_analysis.reason: Real discrete spectrum, no Lorentzian time ordering on S4
euclidean_s4_analysis.implication: I(h_-,eps) = I^{+++} = I^{---} = I^{++-} = ... for all (i,j,k). This is the SYM topology.  The loop appears IDENTICALLY on both branches.
euclidean_s4_analysis.zero_mode_note: The l=0 mode (lambda_0=0) is the zero mode.  It requires careful treatment in the h_->0 limit.  The endpoint-split validation (Gate 3 criterion 4) confirmed that this limit is numerically controlled.
euclidean_s4_analysis.role_implication: shared_normalization (pi/2 cancels in R=N/D on pure Euclidean S4)
euclidean_s4_analysis.ctp_causality: SYM topology automatically satisfies V_aaa=0 (see CTP causality check)
euclidean_s4_analysis.caveat: This conclusion applies to PURE Euclidean S4.  If the GRUT action involves: (a) Lorentzian continuation (de Sitter, not S4), (b) sector-specific couplings (C_cosmo != C_final), or (c) a spontaneous breaking of CTP branch symmetry, then the loop may contribute asymmetrically.

scenario_A.name: pi/2 is shared_normalization (cancels in R)
scenario_A.mechanism: CTP branch symmetry → pi/2 in both N and D → cancels
scenario_A.requires: Identification of C_cosmo and C_final as separate theory quantities

scenario_B.name: pi/2 is quotient-bearing (enters R on one side)
scenario_B.mechanism: Sector asymmetry: N uses S4 scalar loop, D uses different loop
scenario_B.requires: Identification of which GRUT sector uses the S4 loop and which sector uses a different loop with coefficient pi*sqrt(3)/4

r_target_analysis.current_conclusion: The Euclidean S4 CTP analysis supports Scenario A (shared_normalization). Scenario B is not excluded but requires a specific asymmetry mechanism that must be identified in the GRUT CTP action.
r_target_analysis.guardrail: Do NOT assign V4 (final_coefficient_candidate) because it produces R=sqrt(4/3). Assign V4 only if the CTP branch structure DEMANDS it.

decision_table.finding: Loop appears identically on both CTP branches (SYM topology)
decision_table.note: pi/2 cancels; R comes from sector prefactor ratio C_cosmo/C_final

decision_table.finding: Loop appears only in response/retarded branch (RESP topology)
decision_table.note: Only possible if Lorentzian CTP structure or sector asymmetry overrides

decision_table.finding: Loop in both branches with unequal sector weights
decision_table.note: R = (C_cosmo * pi/2) / (C_final * pi/2 * weight_ratio) — pi/2 partially cancels

decision_table.finding: Loop not a vertex in the GRUT CTP action
decision_table.note: pi/2 validates numerical extraction route only

decision_table.finding: Branch placement cannot be determined from available evidence

summary.blocking_question: Does the GRUT CTP action assign equal S4 scalar loop coefficients to both N and D sectors (Scenario A: pi/2 cancels), or different coefficients (Scenario B: pi/2 is quotient-bearing)?
